period_note: Extracted from Trust Bank's own annual-report-embedded 'Audit Committee and the Board Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table (a BSEC corporate-governance-mandated disclosure). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 of the same year (the source table's own column header reads '01 Jan to <quarter-end date>'), not discrete-quarter figures, flagged via the _cumulative suffix; balance-sheet items are the period-end snapshot. BASIS MISMATCH FLAGGED: this table's own text states the Board approved the CONSOLIDATED financial statements for quarterly disclosure every year it appears (2018, 2020-2025) — this differs from Trust Bank's main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is SOLO (Bank-only, unconsolidated) basis for balance-sheet/income-statement items (see sources.json top-level reporting_basis, confirmed 2026-08-26). Verified numerically for FY2020: this table's own Q4/full-year column reports Total Assets 356,458 (Consolidated) vs this dataset's SOLO-basis FY2020 Q4 Total Assets 354,778.33 — a 0.47% gap, consistent with Trust Bank's small subsidiaries (Trust Bank Investment Ltd, Trust Bank Securities Ltd, Trust Axiata Digital Ltd) being added net of intercompany eliminations on consolidation, not a data error. Do not directly mix these CONSOLIDATED Q1-Q3 figures with this bank's SOLO-basis Q4/annual figures without adjusting for this basis gap. Source document is a LATER annual report's comparative-year column for FY2020 (FY2020's own annual report does not contain usable data for this). Sourced from the FY2021 report's comparative column rather than FY2020's own copy of this table: FY2020's own PDF-to-text extraction lost row-boundary structure for several balance-sheet sub-items (Cash/Investment/Loans rows), including one internal inconsistency (its own 'Loans and Advances' row printed the same figure, 204,479, for both FY2019 Q3 and FY2020 Q3, which cannot both be correct). The FY2021 report's comparative column has no such issue and reproduces the core aggregates (Total Assets, Deposits, Total Liabilities, Total Equity, Off-Balance Sheet, Net Interest Income, Operating Income/Expenses, Profit Before Provision, Net Profit After Tax, EPS) IDENTICALLY to FY2020's own report for all of Q1-Q3 — those items are high-confidence; Loans/Investments/Fixed-Assets/Paid-up-Capital for FY2020 are taken from the FY2021 report specifically to avoid the corrupted FY2020-report row.
